subject: Literature
title: Macbeth and the Corruption of Ambition
description: Learn Macbeth and the Corruption of Ambition in one minute.

hook.text: Three witches tell a loyal general he will become king, and that single prophecy destroys everything he loves.

buildup.text: Macbeth murders his king, his friends, and eventually innocent children to protect his stolen throne.

discovery.text: Lady Macbeth drives the initial murder but is later consumed by guilt, sleepwalking and washing imaginary blood.

twist.text: Actors consider the play cursed and refuse to say its name in theatres, calling it 'the Scottish play' instead.

climax.text: Macbeth remains the most powerful study of how ambition can corrupt even the most honorable person.

punchline.text: A prophecy of power became a sentence of destruction.

quiz.question: Why do actors call Macbeth 'the Scottish play'?
options: Because it is set in Scotland
They consider it cursed and refuse to say its name in theatres
